evals.prompt: Reproduce this bug with a failing test first
evals.expected_output: Skill should trigger. Cowork should follow the bug-driven TDD protocol in references/bug_driven_tdd.md — capture the bug in .cc/bugs/<bug-id>.md, write a failing unit test that reproduces it, confirm RED before any fix is written.

evals.prompt: Write the pytest that captures this bug
evals.expected_output: Skill should trigger. Cowork should generate a pytest case per references/bug_driven_tdd.md that minimally reproduces the bug, confirm it fails on current main, then proceed to the fix-and-green stage.

evals.prompt: Why do we need both a unit and browser test for the fix?
evals.expected_output: Skill should trigger. Cowork should explain the four-greens rule from references/bug_driven_tdd.md: unit RED -> unit GREEN -> browser RED -> browser GREEN, and why both layers are required before a bug is closed.

evals.prompt: Apply bug-driven TDD to this failure
evals.expected_output: Skill should trigger. Cowork should execute the full bug-driven TDD workflow from references/bug_driven_tdd.md: create .cc/bugs/<bug-id>.md, write failing unit + browser tests, implement fix, verify all four greens, commit.

evals.prompt: Confirm four greens before closing the bug
evals.expected_output: Skill should trigger. Cowork should verify the four-greens checklist from references/bug_driven_tdd.md — unit RED captured, unit GREEN after fix, browser RED captured, browser GREEN after fix — and only then mark the bug closed.

Skill should trigger. Cowork should describe the .cc/bugs/<bug-id>.md template per references/bug_driven_tdd.md and assets/bug_report_template.md — repro steps, expected vs actual, failing-test pointers, fix commit, four-greens evidence.

evals.prompt: Don't fix without a failing test
evals.expected_output: Skill should trigger. Cowork should enforce the no-fix-without-RED rule from references/bug_driven_tdd.md — block the fix attempt, demand a failing test first, and document the repro in .cc/bugs/<bug-id>.md.

evals.prompt: Explain how to roast coffee beans at home
evals.expected_output: Skill should NOT trigger — unrelated to bug-driven TDD or Claude Code orchestration.
